summary: Frontend-only verification of Spirit Guides chat header + empty-state redesign. All 10 acceptance criteria PASSED against the deployed Expo web preview using admin creds. Header renders back arrow + guide hero IMAGE (Ignis flame face inside circle) + name/subtitle (both truncated with numberOfLines={1}) + 3 right-side action buttons (green book, people-icon Switch Guide chip with aria-label='Switch Guide', purple speaker). No floating 'Switch Guide' pill exists between header and body (text occurrence count = 0). Chat body shows greeting bubble followed by '✨ Try asking me…' section with all 5 expected chip prompts. Tapping a chip prefills the composer (verified value = 'How can I raise my vibration?') and does NOT auto-send (greeting still only appears once). Volume/mute button toggles bidirectionally between volume-high (\uf613) and volume-mute (\uf61c) glyphs; muted state visually applies muteButtonActive styling (red-tinted icon confirmed in screenshot /tmp/07_muted.png). Tapping the Switch Guide chip returns to the guide-selection screen ('Select your guide' visible; selectedGuide cleared).
action_items: OPTIONAL: Add testID attributes to ChatHeader action buttons (save-journal-button, switch-guide-chip, mute-button) and to suggested-prompt chips for more robust future automation. Currently we relied on aria-label='Switch Guide' and Ionicon glyph unicode inspection.
OPTIONAL: Repeated Layout warning in console: 'No route named "files" exists in nested children' — unrelated to this task but worth investigating in a future pass.
OPTIONAL: Console warns about deprecated 'shadow*', 'textShadow*', and 'props.pointerEvents' style props — not caused by this change but flagged for cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatHeader.tsx composition looks clean: pulse rings gated by `isTalking && ringColors`, falls back to single-ring animation using guide.color, then falls back to icon-only avatar if no image. Good defensive rendering.
spirit-guides.tsx onSwitchGuide handler correctly clears both selectedGuide AND messages, ensuring next selection shows a fresh greeting. onBack additionally resets divinePairMode — correct.

Suggested-prompts gate is `messages.length <= 1 && !loading` — matches spec (only visible on initial greeting; hides once user sends and loading begins, then stays hidden because messages.length grows to 2+).
Chip onPress uses setInputText(prompt) only — no auto-send, matching requested behavior.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow gotcha: the login page has TWO 'Sign In' texts — the top-left header nav AND the submit button. Use `page.get_by_text('Sign In', exact=True).last` to hit the button. After login the app redirects to '/' — navigate to '/spirit-guides' explicitly. Ionicons render as Unicode glyphs (volume-high=\uf613, volume-mute=\uf61c, book=\uf1a5, people=\uf49f) which can be inspected via container.children innerText when testID is absent.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this was a verification pass on an already-applied fix, not a bug reproduction.
